latin: Potentia respectiua materiae non addit supra materiam rem, sed rationem.
translation: A relative potency in matter adds to matter not a further thing, but only a further concept.
translation_note: 'res'/'ratio' (thing/concept) mark the standard scholastic distinction between a real addition and a merely conceptual one (Farmer's note, farmer1998:11224). Sense checked against farmer1998:11207.
